blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Fully online on-policy distillation (OPD) is costly for long-horizon agents because each update depends on fresh environment rollouts. Prefix replay offers an efficient alternative by sampling current-student responses from stored histories, reducing idle time for long-tail rollouts and allowing each collected trajectory to support multiple updates. However, our analysis of the complete prefix replay pipeline identifies two limitations in long-horizon settings. In trajectory collection, teacher-only trajectories miss student-induced histories, while broader history coverage can reduce teacher reliability. In trajectory reuse, fixed position-based schedules cannot identify critical decisions that may occur at any trajectory depth. We introduce CARE-OPD (Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence) to address both limitations. Student-seeded teacher completions and response-level confidence gating expand history coverage while filtering unreliable updates. Hindsight replay allocation then uses downstream execution evidence to select consequential turns. Across long-horizon tasks Software Engineering and Deep Research, CARE-OPD outperforms online OPD and prior prefix replay baselines. On SWE-bench Verified, it raises task success to 59.5% while reducing end-to-end training time by 45% and environment actions by 44% relative to asynchronous online OPD.
blocks.zh: 全面在线政策蒸馏(OPD)对于长视剂来说成本高昂,因为每次更新都取决于新鲜环境的推出. 前缀重放提供了一个高效的替代方案,从所储存的历史中取样流子学生的响应,减少长尾展开的闲置时间,并允许所收集的每个轨迹支持多个更新. 然而,我们对完整前缀回放管道的分析确定了长视环境的两个局限性. 在轨迹收集中,只有教师的轨迹错过了学生引起的历史,而更广泛的历史覆盖范围可以降低教师的可靠性. 在轨迹再利用中,基于固定位置的时间表无法确定可能在任何轨迹深度上作出的关键决定。 我们引入了CARE-OPD(Collect for CoverAge, Replay with Effective),以解决这两个局限性. 学生种子教师完成和响应级信心相克扩大了历史覆盖范围,同时过滤不可靠的更新. Hindsight再播放分配,然后使用下游执行证据来选择相应的转弯. 在整个长视野任务软件工程和深层研究中,CARE-OPD在在线OPD和前缀重放基线上都超越了业绩. 在SWE-bench验证中,它将任务成功率提高到59.5%,同时相对于同步在线OPD将端到端培训时间减少45%,环境行动减少44%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own responses while a stronger teacher supplies dense token-level targets [ 9 , 1 ] . Fully online OPD for interactive agents executes the student in the environment [ 27 ] , so training covers histories induced by the student’s actions. This alignment becomes expensive over long horizons spanning tens or hundreds of agent turns. A rollout may search a repository, issue web queries, and wait for external tools, so trajectory durations can differ substantially. Synchronous training batches wait for their slowest trajectories, whereas asynchronous pipelines reduce synchronization idle time but still retain the full interaction cost and can introduce stale-policy data [ 12 , 2 ] . Long and heterogeneous rollouts therefore make training much slower than the model update alone.
blocks.zh: 政策蒸馏(OpD)对学生进行自己的反应培训,而更强大的教师则提供密集的符号级目标[9,1]. 互动代理的完全在线OPD在环境中执行学生[27],因此培训涵盖学生行为引发的历史. 这种配合在数十或数百个代理人转弯的漫长视野中变得昂贵。 推出可能搜索一个寄存器,发布网络查询,并等待外部工具,因此轨迹持续时间可能有很大差异. 同步训练批次等待其最慢的轨迹,而同步管道则减少同步闲置时间,但仍保留全部交互成本,并可引入 stale-political data [12, 2]. 因此,长期和多样化的推出使培训速度远远慢于仅模型更新。

blocks.en: Prefix replay offers an off-environment alternative. A separate collection stage records multi-turn trajectories from fixed policy snapshots. During training, the learner selects a stored prefix, generates a response of only one turn from the current student, and evaluates the teacher along that response. The generated response is not executed in the environment. Prefix replay therefore removes variable-length environment rollouts from the learner’s critical path and allows one executed trajectory to support repeated current-student updates.
blocks.zh: 前缀重播提供了一个非环境选项. 单独的收集阶段记录了固定政策快照的多回合轨迹。 在训练期间,学习者会选择一个存储的前缀,从现在的学生中产生一个只有一个转折的响应,并沿着这个响应来评价老师. 生成的响应不会在环境中执行 。 因此,前缀重放会从学习者的关键路径中删除可变长度的环境展开,并允许一个已执行的轨道支持重复的当前学生更新 。

blocks.en: Prefix replay reduces training cost by constructing updates from stored histories rather than fresh environment rollouts. The quality of these updates depends on two design choices: which histories to collect so that replay reflects situations the student may face while retaining reliable teacher supervision, and which turns to replay so that training focuses on decisions worth learning . Concurrent work ReOPD collects teacher-generated histories and uses a monotone position-decay schedule to favor early prefixes [ 18 ] . This design makes both parts of replay static: collection fixes the history source to the teacher, while allocation within each collected trajectory depends only on turn position. These choices are restrictive for long-horizon agents, where early actions can alter many later turns, and consequential decisions can occur at any depth. We address the resulting collection and reuse challenges in turn.
blocks.zh: 重新播放前缀可以减少培训费用,办法是从存储的历史中构建更新,而不是推出新的环境。 这些更新的质量取决于两个设计选择:哪些历史可以收集,从而反映学生在保留可靠的教师监督的同时可能面临的情况;以及哪些历史可以重新播放,从而使培训侧重于值得学习的决定。 同时期工作 ReOPD 收集教师生成的历史,并使用单调位置decay表来偏好早期前缀 [18]. 这种设计使得两部分的重放静态:收藏将历史源固定给老师,而每个收集的轨迹内部的分配则只取决于转弯位置. 这些选择对远视代理人是限制性的,早期行动可以改变许多后来的转折,因此在任何深度都可以做出相应的决定. 我们依次应对由此产生的收集和再利用挑战。

blocks.en: The first challenge is to pair student-relevant histories with confident teacher supervision. Teacher-only trajectories omit states reached after student errors, and this history mismatch compounds over long horizons [ 22 , 14 ] . To cover situations that the student may face, a frozen student generates an initial segment before the teacher completes the trajectory. These student-induced histories make the replay contexts more relevant to the student, but they may fall outside the teacher’s usual interaction distribution. We therefore pair student-seeded teacher completions with response-level confidence gating: collection broadens coverage toward student-induced histories, while the gate retains responses for which the teacher provides a confident target.
blocks.zh: 第一个挑战是将学生相关历史与有信心的教师监督联系起来。 只有教师的轨迹省略了学生出错后达到的状态,这种历史错配复合了长视野[22,14]. 为了涵盖学生可能面临的情况,被冻结的学生会在教师完成轨迹前产生初始部分. 这些学生引起的历史使得重播背景与学生更为相关,但它们可能不属于教师通常的互动分布范围。 因此,我们把学生种子的教师毕业与响应水平的信心挂钩:收集将覆盖范围扩大到学生引起的历史,而大门则保留了教师提供自信目标的反应。

blocks.en: The second challenge is to identify which turns in a long trajectory are worth replaying. Long trajectories interleave routine interactions with consequential diagnoses, corrections, and verification decisions [ 16 ] . Replaying every turn spends training computation on steps with limited learning value, while position decay can suppress valuable decisions that occur late in the trajectory [ 18 ] . We instead allocate replay after observing the completed trajectory, when later execution feedback and the final outcome can support the value of earlier decisions. After each rollout, we append a selection query to the rollout teacher and reuse its trajectory KV cache to select these evidence-supported turns efficiently.
blocks.zh: 第二个挑战是确定哪些转折在漫长的轨道上值得重现。 较长的轨迹与相应的诊断、更正和核查决定之间的例行互动[16]。 重放每个转折都花费在学习价值有限的步骤上进行训练计算,而位置衰变可以压制在轨迹晚期出现的有价值的决定[18]. 我们在观察完成的轨迹后再分配回放,而后来的执行反馈和最终结果可以支持先前决定的价值. 每次推出后,我们将一个选择查询附加到推出老师身上,并重新使用其轨迹 KV 缓存来高效地选择这些证据支持的转向.

Under matched hardware, CARE-OPD reduces end-to-end training time by 45% and executes 56% as many environment interactions as fully online OPD. On two long-horizon tasks SWE and Deep Research, it improves task success over all prefix replay and fully online OPD methods. We make three contributions:

blocks.en: (2) We develop an adaptive replay method that addresses both problems. Student-seeded teacher completions cover histories induced by student behavior, while response-level confidence gating filters uncertain teacher supervision. blocks.en: (3) We evaluate the complete training process on Software Engineering and Deep Research tasks. The method improves task performance over fully online OPD and prefix replay methods while reducing wall-clock time and environment interactions. Therefore, we establish prefix replay as a practical environment-decoupled training regime for long-horizon agents.
blocks.zh: (3)我们评价软件工程和深入研究任务的完整培训过程。 该方法比完全在线的OPD和前缀重播方法提高了任务性能,同时减少了墙钟时间和环境互动. 因此,我们把前缀重放作为长视距人员实际的除环培训制度。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Efficient Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.1 高效的多重政策扭曲

blocks.en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own responses using a teacher’s next-token distribution [ 9 , 1 , 7 ] . Recent extensions adapt OPD to multi-turn agents through teacher intervention, budget-aware rollout and loss allocation, hybrid objectives, and asynchronous rollout pipelines [ 15 , 30 , 23 , 12 , 2 ] . These methods retain live environment execution during student training.
blocks.zh: 政策蒸馏(OPD)用教师的近亲分布来训练学生自己的反应[9, 1, 7]. 近期的扩展通过教师干预,预算意识的推出和损失分配,混合目标,以及同步推出管道[15,30,23,12,2],使OPD适应多回合代理. 这些方法保留了学生培训期间的现场环境处决.

blocks.en:
Prefix replay collects histories independently and trains on current-student responses generated from stored prefixes, keeping environment execution off the training process. Concurrent work ReOPD reuses prefixes from teacher-generated trajectories and assigns each turn a sampling probability that decreases monotonically with its position in the trajectory, thereby favoring earlier turns [ 18 ] . We find that this step-decay schedule cannot effectively transfer to long-horizon tasks spanning tens or hundreds of turns.
We analyze the complete prefix replay pipeline for long-horizon tasks and identify the limitations in both stages, trajectory collection and reuse. We deal with both: student-seeded teacher completions expand history coverage under response-level confidence control, while downstream execution evidence allocates replay across the completed trajectory.
blocks.zh:
前缀重放独立收集历史,并用存储前缀生成的当前学生响应进行训练,使环境执行远离训练过程. 同时期工作 ReOPD 重用教师生成的轨迹的前缀,并指定每个转动的采样概率随其在轨迹中的位置单调降低,从而倾向于更早的转动[18]. 我们认为,这一逐步取消的时间表不能有效地转移到跨越数十或数百个转弯的长距离任务。
我们分析用于长视距任务的完整前缀重播管道,并找出两个阶段的局限性,轨迹收集和再利用. 我们既要处理两个问题:学生种子教师的完成在反应层面的信心控制下扩大了历史覆盖面,而下游的执行证据则在完成的轨迹上进行重播。

blocks.en: 2.2 Selecting Histories and Updates in OPD
blocks.zh: 2.2 在OPD中选择历史和更新

blocks.en: OPD depends on both the teacher target and the histories where the teacher is queried. Fully online OPD uses student-induced histories, while Guided-OPD mixes teacher- and student-generated turns through an intervention curriculum [ 15 ] . TrOPD restricts OPD to regions with reliable teacher supervision and uses teacher prefixes for off-policy guidance [ 26 ] . These methods control the tension between student-relevant histories and teacher reliability through online intervention and trust regions. CARE-OPD instead constructs a replay pool with student-seeded teacher completions, then reassesses teacher confidence after the current student samples a response.
blocks.zh: 发展办公室取决于教师对象和询问教师的历史。 Fully在线OPD使用学生引起的历史,而Guided-OPD则通过干预课程混合教师和学生产生的转折[15]. TrOPD将OPD限制在有可靠教师监督的地区,并使用教师前缀进行非政策指导[26]. 这些方法通过在线干预和信任区域控制学生相关历史与教师可靠性之间的紧张关系。 援外社-OPD则用学生种子的教师完成建造一个重播池,然后在目前学生取样后重新评估教师的信心。

blocks.en: Several OPD methods also select or weight supervision within a trajectory. TurnOPD allocates rollout and loss budgets using turn-level statistics, SAGE-OPD selects teacher interventions from environment feedback and weights supervision by teacher confidence, and ATOD reweights turns using teacher–student disagreement and uncertainty [ 30 , 28 , 23 ] . Other work masks or reweights OPD supervision using self-uncertainty, token teachability, or position-dependent teacher reliability [ 13 , 25 , 19 ] . These rules derive their decisions from online trajectories, model distributions, or token position. Our replay setting adds an allocation decision over stored prefixes: evidence from the completed trajectory determines where the replay loss is evaluated, and teacher confidence on the newly sampled response determines whether that loss contributes an update.
blocks.zh: 几种OPD方法也在轨迹内选择或加权监督. TurnOPD利用转关统计来分配推广和损失预算,SAGE-OPD从教师信心的环境反馈和权重监督中选择教师干预,ATOD则利用教师-学生的分歧和不确定性来进行重新加权[30,28,23]. 其他工作口罩或重新加权 OPD 监督,使用自我不确定性,象征性的教学性,或依赖位置的教师可靠性 [13, 25, 19]. 这些规则从在线轨迹,模型发行,或符号位置中得出他们的决定. 我们的重播设定在存储前缀上添加了一个分配决定:来自完成的轨迹的证据决定了重播损失的评价地点,老师对新取样的响应的信心决定了损失是否有助于更新.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We study two long-horizon agentic tasks: Software Engineering (SWE) and Deep Research. For Software Engineering , we partition SWE-Gym [ 21 ] into a training set and a validation set of 100 tasks. We collect all training trajectories from the training set and evaluate task success on SWE-bench Verified [ 11 ] . For Deep Research , as high-quality data is important, we use a dataset curated from public sources with a quality-control pipeline, detailed in Appendix A . We evaluate answer accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus [ 3 ] , using Qwen3-Embedding-8B as the retriever and gpt-oss-20b as the judge.
blocks.zh: 我们研究两个长视距的代理任务:软件工程(SWE)和深度研究(Deep Research). 对于软件工程,我们将 SWE-Gym [21] 分割成一个训练集和一个由100项任务组成的验证集. 我们从培训中收集所有的培训轨迹,并评估在SWE-bench验证[11]上的任务成功情况。 对于Deep Research,由于高质量的数据很重要,我们使用从公共来源整理的数据集,其中包含一个质量控制管道,详见附录A。 我们用Qune3-Embedding-8B作为检索器,gpt-oss-20b作为判断器,在浏览comp-Plus [3] 上评价答案精度.

blocks.en: For SWE, we use OpenHands as the agent scaffold and retain its default system prompt and tools [ 24 ] . For Deep Research, we customize the Uni-Agent scaffold [ 6 ] and provide three tools: search , open , and find . SFT and OPD training both use a 128K context limit and a 150-turn limit.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: This result holds across all three settings, showing that adaptive history construction and replay allocation allow environment-decoupled replay to surpass training on fresh online trajectories. The following paragraphs analyze these comparisons in detail.
blocks.zh: 这一结果涵盖所有三种环境,表明适应历史构造和重播分配使环境分离的重播能够超越关于新鲜在线轨迹的培训。 以下段落详细分析了这些比较。

blocks.en: The two online variants differ by only 1.4, 0.1, and 1.6 points across the three settings, with no consistent winner. On Qwen3.5 SWE-bench Verified, trajectories average 84.9 turns, yet random-turn OPD scores 1.4 points higher. Less reliable targets after accumulated student errors in long trajectories may limit the value of full-trajectory distillation. However, vanilla prefix replay trails one-turn online OPD by 4.0, 1.2, and 3.2 points. This contrast points to fixed teacher-generated prefixes and absent environment execution, rather than one-turn supervision itself: replay cannot reach later histories induced by the current student’s decisions. Section 4.3 below shows the trade-off: vanilla prefix replay is substantially cheaper but less effective.
blocks.zh: 两个在线变体仅差1.4分,0.1分,三种设置各得1.6分,没有一致的胜负. 在Qwen3.5 SWE-bench验证中,轨迹平均84.9转,然而随机转动的OPD得分却高出1.4分. 在长轨积存的学生误差后,不太可靠的目标可能限制全轨蒸馏值. 然而,香草前缀以4.0,1.2,3.2的分数重播线条在线OPD的一转. 这种对比表明,固定的教师产生的前缀和缺失的环境执行,而不是一转监督本身:重播无法到达目前学生的决定所引发的后期历史。 下文第4.3节显示权衡:香草前缀重播成本低得多,但效果较低。

blocks.en: Relative to vanilla prefix replay, ReOPD changes performance by +0.2, -0.4, and +1.2 points. Its monotone schedule assumes that useful supervision concentrates near the trajectory start. Long-horizon agents also make consequential diagnoses, corrections, and verification decisions at later turns, so fixed decay can suppress useful examples. Section 4.5 examines this limitation directly. Together, the online and replay comparisons show that more supervision is not consistently better: full-trajectory OPD does not reliably beat one-turn OPD, and position decay does not reliably beat uniform replay. CARE-OPD instead adapts history coverage and selects turns from trajectory evidence, consistent with its gains over both replay variants.
blocks.zh: 相对于香草前缀重播,ReOPD以+0.2,-0.4和+1.2分改变性能. 它的单酮时间表假定有用的监督集中在轨迹开始点附近。 长视剂在后期也会做出相应的诊断,校正和核查决定,因此固定衰变可以压制有用的例子. 第4.5节直接审查了这一限制。 在线和重播的比较加在一起表明,更多的监管不是一贯的更好:全轨OPD不能可靠地击败一转OPD,位置衰变也不能可靠地击败统一的重播. 相反,CARE-OPD调整了历史覆盖范围,从轨迹证据中选择转弯,这符合其在两个变体上的收益。

By decoupling environment interaction from student training, vanilla prefix replay and CARE-OPD reduce end-to-end time by 61% and 60% relative to synchronous one-turn OPD, and by 47% and 45% relative to asynchronous one-turn OPD. Both replay methods also execute approximately 45% fewer environment actions than either online baseline because each collected trajectory supports repeated prefix updates. blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和结论

blocks.en: Although our student-seeded collection broadens history coverage, it uses a frozen initial student and bounded roll-ins, while the student changes during training. The replay pool may therefore become less representative over time. Periodically refreshing the pool could reduce this mismatch at additional environment cost. Replayed responses are not executed, leaving their validity and environmental consequences unobserved. Teacher confidence measures distributional certainty rather than response correctness. Future work could selectively execute uncertain responses or develop execution-aware correctness estimators.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的学生种子集拓宽了历史的覆盖范围,但它使用冷冻的初始学生和捆绑的滚入,而学生在训练时会改变. 因此,随着时间推移,重玩池可能变得不那么具有代表性。 定期刷新水池可以减少这种不匹配,而增加环境成本。 复述的答复没有执行,使其有效性和环境后果不受注意。 教师信心衡量的是分布确定性,而不是反应正确。 今后的工作可以有选择地执行不确定的对策,或者制定了解执行情况的正确估计。

blocks.en: On-policy distillation is expensive for long-horizon agents because each update typically requires a fresh environment rollout. We study prefix replay as an efficient alternative, and our analysis identifies two central design problems: trajectory collection and trajectory reuse. We introduce CARE-OPD, which addresses trajectory collection with reliability-controlled history coverage and trajectory reuse with evidence-based allocation. CARE-OPD outperforms online OPD and prior prefix replay methods across long-horizon tasks SWE and Deep Research. On SWE-bench Verified, it achieves 59.5% task success with 45% less end-to-end training time and 44% fewer environment actions than asynchronous online OPD. Further analyses show that adaptive collection and reuse make prefix replay an effective and efficient training approach for long-horizon agents.
blocks.zh: 政策上蒸馏对于远视剂来说是昂贵的,因为每次更新一般都需要新鲜的环境推广. 我们研究前缀重放作为一种高效的替代品,我们的分析发现了两个中心设计问题:轨迹收集和轨迹再利用. 我们引进了援外社-OPD,它处理轨迹收集问题,涉及可靠性控制的历史覆盖范围,以及轨迹再利用和循证分配。 CARE-OPD超越了在线OPD和前缀重播方法,跨越长视任务SWE和Deep Research. 在SWE-bench验证上,它实现了59.5%的任务成功率,减少了45%的端到端培训时间,环境行动比同步在线OPD少了44%. 进一步的分析表明,适应性的收集和再利用使前缀重新成为长视距剂的一种切实有效的培训方法。

blocks.en: Because the source corpora were collected with different pipelines and at different times, their query–answer pairs vary in quality and current verifiability. We use DeepSeek-V4-Flash [ 5 ] as a task-level answerability probe in a common live-web environment. The probe can call search , open , and find , while web search and reading use Serper 1 1 1 https://serper.dev/ . We retain a candidate when the probe’s final answer is consistent with the source reference and supported by evidence available in the current web environment. This pass screens for ambiguous queries, stale reference answers, and questions whose supporting evidence is no longer accessible. It also reduces variation caused by source-specific retrieval environments. After filtering, the remaining 16,855 tasks form the curated training dataset for Deep Research.

blocks.en: Performance is stable across the tested student-seeding fractions. Mean task success is 59.5%, 59.1%, and 58.8% at α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 , 0.3, and 0.5, respectively. These configuration means span 0.7 points over the tested interval. We use α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 , which gives the highest task success while requiring student roll-ins for only 10% of the collected trajectories.

blocks.en: Rejecting a small low-confidence fraction is sufficient. Task success decreases markedly as γ \gamma increases. Because the gate removes the lowest-confidence fraction of each minibatch, increasing γ \gamma progressively discards more candidate updates. This decline suggests that most of the benefit comes from filtering a small set of potentially unreliable updates, while stronger rejection removes useful supervision.
blocks.zh: 拒绝一个小的低信心部分就足够了。 随着\gamma的增加,任务成功率明显下降。 因为门取消了每个小批量中最低的自信部分,增加 γ\gamma 逐渐放弃更多的候选更新. 这一下降表明,大部分好处来自过滤出一小组可能不可靠的更新,而更强烈的拒绝会消除有用的监督.

blocks.en: Hindsight allocation benefits from a moderate selection budget. Selecting 20% of the eligible turns yields 57.5% mean task success, while r = 0.4 r=0.4 and r = 0.6 r=0.6 reach 59.5% and 59.3%, respectively. Performance decreases slightly to 58.7% at r = 0.8 r=0.8 . With r = 0.2 r=0.2 , the judge selects few turns and therefore covers a narrower set of trajectory states. We also observe that small selection fractions concentrate selected turns near trajectory starts, which can omit later corrections, recovery actions, and verification steps.
blocks.zh: 明目张胆的拨款得益于适度的选择预算。 选择20%的合格轮值平均完成57.5%的任务,而r=0.4 r=0.4和r=0.6 r=0.6分别达到59.5%和59.3%。 在r=0.8r=0.8时,性能略有下降至58.7%。 在r = 0.2 r = 0.2的情况下,法官选择几个转弯,因此覆盖了较窄的一组轨迹状态. 我们还观察到,小部分选择集中了选定的转弯,接近轨迹开始,这可以省略以后的更正、恢复行动和核查步骤。
